name: P1 with the recall memory's context in the key, the better context recipe against the founder with the memory off
question: On P1's development founder 1001, with Brain.compose(..., memory_choice=True): is frozen whole-chain success after teaching, and after 80 episodes alone, at or above the founder's through step and through live when the recall memory carries context in its key (the better of recall_context 0.5 and 1.0 on the screen)?
scope: component prerequisite behavior in a fully observed world; a memoryless stage-aware policy solves it, so it tests no memory; a witness that the added regions leave the fully observed chain as it was, not a gate of the library branch; a follow-up of protocol-recall-p1.json, whose founder row on 1001 is retained (rs-p1) and not rerun

founder.note: V5's layout with the episodic memory at the library's defaults, the recall memory off; retained from the first reading's run (rs-p1), not rerun

recall_ctx05.note: the recall recipe plus recall_context=0.5, recall_context_decay=0.5: a moment's key and address are the event heard plus half of the fading history of the events before it (history = 0.5 * history + event after each witnessed moment); the same wiring and initial weights

recall_ctx10.note: the same with recall_context=1.0: the history weighs as much as the event in the key and the address

correct_step_qualified.note: the same caregiver with qualified teaching; a separately named numerical arm, refusals counted at the fixed budget

schedule.unit: executed decisions of the whole life

caregiver.label: the required action of the observation shown now, after an executed nonterminal mistake in a guided window

withdrawal: the acquired life resumes from its seam with the caregiver gone and learning on; a separate frozen copy is read at the end

evaluation.note: frozen copies with their own action stream; Brain.reset at every episode start equals the life's episode boundary for an act-only reader; one greedy episode, since every greedy episode from a reset reads the same deterministic answers

seeds.note: founder 1001, the better context recipe of the screen only (--recipes <it>), if time allows after the screen; the founder row is the first reading's

analysis.unit: founder; a pair is one arm on founder 1001, the context recipe against the founder recipe (retained) and against the first reading's recall recipe (retained)
analysis.readings: per arm, step and live: sampled and greedy success after teaching and after 80 episodes alone, per-state greedy accuracy at both points; point readings on one founder
analysis.report: on one founder the differences are point readings; with the extension founders a percentile bootstrap (10,000 resamples) over founders as in the earlier lane
analysis.control_check: the founder row is retained; no rerun, no check
